name: quillpad
description: Quillpad — a pocket sketching & painting app for iPhone and Android (web canvas + Capacitor).

scripts.android: node scripts/setup-native.mjs android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node scripts/setup-native.mjs ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:android: node scripts/setup-native.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
